items.summary_cn: Musk放话：SpaceX的AI营收下月将超过其整个航天业务，重大看多信号，直接利好kcn SPCX/SPCH。

items.text: SpaceX could make $500 billion in 2028, Elon Musk says (video)
items.summary_cn: Musk称SpaceX到2028年可能做到5000亿美元营收，宏大叙事利好kcn SPCX/SPCH持仓估值。

items.text: See How a Tesla-SpaceX Merger Gives Musk a Shortcut to His $1 Trillion Payday
items.summary_cn: 媒体分析Tesla-SpaceX潜在合并将为Musk带来1万亿美元薪酬捷径，若合并落地将极大重估SPCX/SPCH。

items.text: SpaceX stock surges as Elon Musk introduces new xAI model Grok 4.6
items.summary_cn: Musk发布xAI新模型Grok 4.6，SpaceX股价应声飙升，强化AI+航天双叙事，利好kcn SPCX/SPCH持仓。

items.author: Musk
items.text: SpaceX Jumps On New Grok Model; Musk Comments
items.summary_cn: SpaceX股价因Musk推介新Grok模型跳涨，直接利好kcn持有的SPCX及2x杠杆SPCH。

items.author: Trump
items.text: The U.S.A. has total control over the Strait of Hormuz. I THINK WE WILL KEEP IT! Our Naval Blockade is being called, by everyone, “A WALL OF STEEL,” and there is nothing Iran can do about it. They have no Navy, they have no Air Force, their remaining soldiers are unpaid, the IRGC is decimated and fleeing, and their “Leadership” is uncertain, at best! They have No Money - Their country is “shot.” All they have is FAKE NEWS and 300% INFLATION, and getting worse! Iran is all talk and no action, the Bully of the Middle East No Longer. Praise be to Allah! President DONALD J. TRUMP
items.summary_cn: Trump声称美国完全控制霍尔木兹海峡、维持海军封锁，称伊朗无还手之力，地缘紧张利好能源/国防主题。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk’s DOGE Promised Savings, But It’s Cost Us a Fortune
items.summary_cn: 媒体批评Musk的DOGE项目'省下的钱远不及付出的代价'，对其政府效率改革成效的负面报道。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Tesla reveals solar plans that could advance Elon Musk's push to outpace US panel capacity
items.summary_cn: Tesla披露太阳能新规划，Musk欲推动超越美国现有光伏产能，利好太阳能产业链但未点名上市公司。

items.author: Musk
items.text: EXCLUSIVE: S&P 500 CEO pay jumps to record as Musk-inspired compensation plans spread
items.summary_cn: Musk式薪酬方案在全美扩散，S&P 500 CEO薪酬创纪录，间接反映其对市场治理范式的影响力。

items.author: Trump
items.text: The NYC Pied-a-Terre Tax is costing New York City and State a fortune in that the money, eventually to be gotten, is very little compared to to the TAXES PAID by the tens of thousands of people who are fleeing the City, never to return. Florida, Texas, and numerous other States, are making an absolute fortune! This dangerous political “experiment” in New York will destroy what was once a great City and State. It is pure Amateur Hour, and it’s hard, as President of the United States of America, to sit back and watch it happen, especially to a place I once loved. Financial, and then Social, RUIN
items.summary_cn: Trump抨击纽约市'度假屋税'(Pied-a-Terre Tax)导致人口和税收外流至佛州、德州等，影射纽约财政/社会走向毁灭。
